central_data_line.relationship: V2 and V3-R1 remain the historical coherent DATA line. EXP-S1-TOPO-PROMO-R1-20260927 prospectively reproduced the bounded topology claim on fresh seeds under the current EvidenceEngine provenance contract and was human-reviewed as supports, producing EVID-2026-19. None of these runs is independent scientific replication.
central_data_line.claim_boundary: Topology-sensitive propagation is supported only in the preregistered 64-neuron/246-edge Small-SNN operating envelope. No 5D superiority, scaling, cognition, biological equivalence or independent replication is established.

second_functional_line.independence_semantics: Independent in functional question/task, not an independent replication of the topology claim.
second_functional_line.claim_boundary: Scoped technical temporal-order function of a six-neuron acyclic two-channel SNN under the registered decoder/task. The simultaneous condition is a non-inferential task-adequacy control. Perfect ceiling/floor separation is an explicit methodological limitation. No learning, memory, cognition, scaling, biological equivalence, 5D advantage, general temporal reasoning or independent replication is established.
second_functional_line.relationship: The historical V2 run remains reviewed DATA. EXP-S1-TEMP-PROMO-R1-20260927 prospectively reproduced the bounded task on fresh seeds under the current EvidenceEngine provenance contract and was human-reviewed as supports with explicit perfect-score/decoder limitations, producing EVID-2026-20. This functional line is not an independent replication of the topology claim.

evid_promotion_assessment.scope: Both central Stage-1 functional lines now have separate canonical human-reviewed EVID. This strengthens Stage-1 evidence breadth but does not satisfy independent replication.
evid_promotion_assessment.remaining_next_step: Pursue independently implemented reference/cross-implementation replication for the central topology claim. The separate topology-efficiency hypothesis remains DRAFT/untested and cannot substitute for the independent-replication criterion.

independent_replication.requirement: Independently controlled and independently authored/audited preregistered replication.

stronger_claims_kept_separate.note: The Stage-1 baseline does not establish a 5D advantage.
